items.title: Markets extend winning streak to third week on FII buying; rupee weakens 33 paise
items.description: Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) extended their buying streak for the third consecutive week, purchasing equities worth Rs 33,342.70 crore.

items.title: Chartist Talk: Will Nifty 50 break above 25,400 next week or extend consolidation? Sudeep Shah picks two stocks
items.description: As long as Nifty sustains above the crucial 24,800 support zone, the overall bullish bias is likely to remain intact, said Sudeep Shah of SBI Securities.

items.title: Alpha Alternatives, Neo Group, Arvesta Financial sell over Rs 224 crore worth of IIFL Capital Services shares
items.description: Collectively, the three entities sold 63.15 lakh shares, representing a 1.69 percent stake in IIFL Capital Services.

items.title: SoftBank sells 1.65% stake in Meesho for Rs 1,885 crore; Fidelity, Societe Generale among 16 buyers
items.description: Fidelity Investments emerged as the biggest buyer, acquiring 2.32 crore equity shares, equivalent to a 0.5 percent stake in the Bengaluru-headquartered e-commerce company, for Rs 573.07 crore through eight of its schemes.

items.title: Nvidia slides 4% as Jensen Huang turmoil deepens; HSBC downgrades stock to 'hold', slashes target by 53%
items.description: The broader market found support from the latest US inflation data, which offered some relief to investors concerned that persistent price pressures could prompt the Federal Reserve to accelerate interest rate hikes.

items.title: Microsoft shares fall 2.5% as massive outage disrupts Outlook, Teams, AI services worldwide
items.description: Microsoft stock had earlier declined 4.45% over two sessions amid renewed concerns about AI posing a threat to traditional software-as-a-service businesses.

items.title: Taking Stock: Market snaps 3-day gains; Nifty below 25,150, Sensex slips 319 pts
items.description: For the week BSE Sensex added 0.7 percent and Nfity50 index rose 0.45 percent.

items.title: Paytm shares reclaim listing price for first time in five years; RBI nod for wallet business boosts sentiment
items.description: Paytm shares crossed their November 2021 listing price of Rs 1,950 for the first time in nearly five years, touching Rs 1,960 intraday after RBI granted in-principle approval for its subsidiary's digital wallet business. The stock closed at Rs 1,934.

items.title: AI's $600 billion debt rush could push up borrowing costs across economy: Howard Mark
items.description: Oaktree co-founder Howard Marks warns that AI's growing demand for capital, with debt issuance nearing $600 billion this year, could reshape credit markets, push up borrowing costs and expose risks in the increasingly interconnected financing arrangements across the AI ecosystem.

items.title: Q2 results impact: FACT shares jump 3% as net profit rises 88% YoY
items.description: The company reported a net profit of Rs 39.28 crore for the quarter, compared with Rs 20.9 crore in the corresponding period last year, marking an increase of 87.9 percent.
